_: Editorial for polo-cruiser. Fabric, fit, size guide, marquee, closing CTA and cross-sell come from _family-polo-classic.json.
_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: A golf cart print. It is exactly as literal as it sounds and it is the most fun thing in the range.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, ideally beside or in an actual cart. The joke lands harder in context, and one close crop is needed for anyone to see what the print is. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
